# Contract Comparison Report — No Documents Provided

Status: Unable to perform a text-level comparison — no contract texts or summaries were supplied.

What I attempted:
- I received an empty list for `doc-summaries`. Without the texts (or structured summaries) of the contracts to compare, I cannot produce a factual, grounded comparison or identify differences between documents.

What I need from you to proceed:
- Provide the contracts (two or more) in one of these forms:
  - Full text of each contract (preferred).
  - Structured summaries that include section headings and the text for each section.
  - A JSON array of document objects (example below) in the `doc-summaries` input field.
- Label each document clearly (e.g., "Agreement A — 2024-01-01", "Agreement B — 2025-03-15").
- If the contracts use different section numbering or headings, indicate any mapping between sections you want compared (or let me align by heading names).

Acceptable example for `doc-summaries` input:
[
  { "title": "Agreement A", "text": "Full contract text or structured sections..." },
  { "title": "Agreement B", "text": "Full contract text or structured sections..." }
]

How I will present the comparison once you provide documents:
- A Markdown report showing overall observations and methodology.
- Per-section diffs with:
  - section-name
  - text from Document A
  - text from Document B
  - a concise difference summary
  - significance flag (major / minor / identical)
- High-level key differences with impact analysis (commercial, legal, operational).
- An executive summary of the most important differences and recommended focus areas.

Next steps:
- Paste the contract texts or upload structured summaries in the `doc-summaries` field and resend. If you prefer, paste only the sections you care most about (e.g., Term, Termination, Limitation of Liability, Indemnity, Payment, Data Protection), and I will compare those.

If you want, I can also provide a sample comparison of two short example clauses so you can confirm the output format before you submit your documents.
result.summary: No contracts were provided. Please supply the contract texts or structured summaries (clearly labeled) and I will produce a detailed, section-by-section comparison with significance and impact analysis.
